behavior.name: RSN Handover Demo
behavior.author: huitao
behavior.description: Linear FlexBE behavior for the RSN voice-guided xArm/ZED handover demo.

param.name: service_timeout_sec
param.label: Service timeout
param.hint: Timeout for normal Trigger service calls.

param.name: voice_timeout_sec
param.label: Voice timeout
param.hint: Maximum time to wait for a voice target.

param.name: wait_for_release_timeout_sec
param.label: Release timeout
param.hint: Maximum time to block on wait_for_release.

param.name: instrument_node_exit_delay_sec
param.label: Instrument exit delay
param.hint: Delay before launching zed_hand_node to let instrument detection release the camera.

param.name: hand_node_startup_delay_sec
param.label: Hand launch delay
param.hint: Delay before checking hand node service availability.

param.name: hand_node_service_timeout_sec
param.label: Hand service timeout
param.hint: Maximum time to wait for hand node services after launch.

param.name: hand_node_params_file
param.label: Hand node params
param.hint: Optional zed_hand_node params file. Empty uses rsn/config/zed_hand_params.yaml.
